retirementNotice: Historical policy snapshot only. It grants no current task admission, preflight, dispatch, model-selection, or execution authority.

authority.source: Direct current user task or standing delegation evidenced in trusted conversation or harness context
authority.scope: Ordinary repository coding and documentation under a trusted mandate; high-risk external effects require their risk-specific grants and evidence
authority.admission: Ordinary tasks use one task-readiness/v1 record and read-only automated preflight; no sealed G0 admission is required
authority.accountableOwner: May be a delegated agent when the trusted mandate binds the delegation

sufficientProvenance: Standing delegation in trusted conversation or harness evidence
trustedAuthorityRecord.legacyOwnerApprovedLabelRule: Reconcile a legacy label to current trusted delegation and actual scope; a stale label alone is not a blocker

authority.historyRule: Historical pins, packet receipts, source reconciliation, terminal records and reservations remain immutable. A metadata-only historical block may be reassessed under the same stable task identity and current authority; record a new dated result linked to the old history. Other blocks are not waived and no budget is refunded.

concurrency.gateSlotReviewMode: Verifier and reviewer sessions run as separate sequential gate turns
concurrency.backpressureAtQueueMaximum: Pause new worker dispatch until the queue is reduced

coordination.parallelism: Independent branches may run in parallel when their dependencies are satisfied by actual accepted artifacts
coordination.dagDependencyEvidence: Every dependency names an actual accepted artifact and its exact revision

gates.highImpactOrUncertainCase: Sol owns technical disposition within the trusted mandate. Production, destructive, security-sensitive and other external effects require their actual risk-specific grant and evidence; missing authority is a typed blocker, not a human approval prompt.
gates.delegatedReleaseActivation: Conditional only when release or activation is part of the task; otherwise mark NOT_APPLICABLE and proceed to SOT closeout. When requested, reuse the existing exact target and environment grant and required gates, with no human prompt. If authority, target binding, or credentials are missing, record a typed blocked action and continue independent eligible work
gates.sotCloseout: Reconcile through the owning canonical source of truth after the authorized delivery action
gates.safeCleanup: Only after closeout and evidence retention, after confirming no active assignment, process, lease, or unpreserved worktree state

notApplicable.allowedWhen: The gate was not requested by the trusted mandate and is not required by repository policy

gates.negativeEvidence: Required evidence and failed acceptance checks prevent READY or gate PASS. Metadata defects route to REPAIR_METADATA; missing mandatory CI or acceptance evidence is never PASS.

failureRouting.triageOwner: Sol for technical, scope, authority or effect ambiguity; ordinary metadata defects are classified and repaired without a separate root gate
failureRouting.triageAccounting: Classify evidence before retry or repair. Proven no-effect metadata repair does not consume implementation, submission, control-plane-successor or execution-cycle capacity. Implementation and submission retries use active per-cycle caps. Exhausted cycles pause for root reassessment; no automatic hot retry or history reset.

routes.condition: Parse, schema, path, quoting or historical receipt defect is proven to have had no product effect
Acceptance evidence fails because of implementation, test, review, integration or CI
routes.boundedBy: Active implementation repair, submission, execution deadline and no-progress caps
routes.reentry: Preserve the same task identity and rerun every invalidated downstream gate

routes.condition: The action needs an external grant, credential, production target or other capability that the mandate does not provide
Effect of an attempted operation cannot be established
The same semantic input is idempotent or prior effectlessness is proven

failureRouting.counterOrDeadlineExhaustionAtAnyGate: Pause the current execution cycle and preserve task identity, cycle history and evidence. A new dated numbered cycle under the same taskId requires root admission after material new evidence or a corrected implementation plan; prior cycle records remain immutable and the semantic no-progress guard remains cumulative.
failureRouting.notApplicable: Use NOT_APPLICABLE only for a gate not requested by the mandate and not required by repository policy; never for mandatory CI or acceptance criteria

gates.automaticTaskPreflight: Read-only task-readiness/v1 evidence for Git base, dependencies, scope and environment. READY grants no authority, reservation, receipt or dispatch.
gates.workerImplementation: Worker implements within the task record writeScope and returns the exact revision, changed paths, self-check evidence and remaining gaps.
gates.independentVerify: A distinct verifier checks the exact submitted revision and acceptance criteria.
gates.independentReview: A distinct reviewer inspects the same exact submitted revision; reviewer session differs from worker and verifier.
gates.rootDelivery: One Sol root delivery responsibility covers in-scope technical and product decisions, integration, authorized commit/push/PR publication and final merge disposition. Authorized publication may collect pending CI; merge or release waits for every applicable acceptance, review, test, exact-head CI and authority gate.
gates.requiredTestsAndExactHeadCi: All repository-required tests and CI remain mandatory. CI attests the exact head; a changed head invalidates affected review and CI evidence. This evidence gates merge and release.
gates.gateOrderScope: Describes the ordinary v4 path. Root delivery is one continuing responsibility that may publish a PR before CI and completes merge only after CI and all applicable gates pass.

acceptanceEvidence.oracleFormat: Nonempty acceptance strings, derived from the roadmap where available; actual outcomes remain separate worker, verifier, review, test and CI evidence.

roleCheckExecution.traceSource: Codex --json JSONL item.started and item.completed events for command_execution items
roleCheckExecution.invocationIdentity: A command_execution item id counts once, correlated from item.started to item.completed
roleCheckExecution.commandMatching: Tokenize the serialized command string with platform quoting rules; resolve executable aliases from the backend PATH and PATHEXT; require exact argv and reject shell or directory-changing prefixes
roleCheckExecution.cwdBinding: Codex CLI 0.162.1 omits per-item cwd from JSONL; only checks whose declared cwd resolves to the worktree root may use launch cwd provenance from --cd worktree
roleCheckExecution.cwdProofLimit: Codex CLI 0.162.1 JSONL does not serialize per-item cwd; summaries identify each invocation as launch_cwd. If an item cwd is present, it is tagged item_cwd. Neither source independently rules out an unreported per-command cwd override
roleCheckExecution.passCondition: Every declared check has a correlated completed invocation with exit_code 0; the most recent invocation must exit 0; its declared cwd must resolve to the --cd worktree root
roleCheckExecution.overLimitAction: Stop the role session when the cap is exceeded and fail closed
roleCheckExecution.evidenceHandling: Hash the complete JSONL trace and emit only hashed item/check identifiers, invocation counts, exit codes, statuses and cwd provenance in the check summary; retain raw command/output only in the private dispatch artifact

lineageIdentity.rootLineageIdDefines: Historical v3 lineage identifier; ordinary v4 tasks use stable taskId.

retryAndLineage.scope: Ordinary v4 retry state is keyed by stable taskId; legacy rootLineageId is used only to audit historical v1 records.

counterSemantics.metadataRepair: No reservation or implementation/submission/control-plane-successor spend. Record the defect; use the no-progress cap only to choose YIELD_REASSESS.
counterSemantics.implementationRepair: Bounded by active per-execution-cycle implementation repair and submission caps; rerun invalidated acceptance, review, test and CI gates.
counterSemantics.rootReassessment: Root may admit a new dated numbered execution cycle under the same taskId only after material new evidence or a corrected implementation plan. Link prior cycle history and reason; do not overwrite or refund prior counters. The semantic no-progress guard remains cumulative across cycles.

deadlineAnchors.run: Starts at the first worker dispatch in each root-admitted bounded execution cycle under taskId. Preflight and metadata repair do not start an execution cycle.
deadlineAnchors.node: Starts at first worker dispatch of the bounded cycle; retries and resumes within the cycle preserve the original start.
deadlineAnchors.boundedWait: Starts when each wait begins; do not poll unchanged input after it expires

retryClassifier.unclassifiedRetryDisposition: BLOCKED_FOR_REASSESSMENT; preserve task identity and evidence
retryClassifier.unknownCounterHistoryDisposition: BLOCK_ONLY_AFFECTED_TASK; never assume zero or silently reset

dispositions.METADATA_DEFECT: REPAIR_METADATA only when no product effect is proven
dispositions.IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE: Bounded implementation repair and new submission
dispositions.EXTERNAL_BLOCKER: Block the affected external action; continue independent work
dispositions.UNKNOWN_EFFECT: Quarantine and reconcile read-only; no retry while unknown
dispositions.KNOWN_TRANSIENT_TOOL_ERROR: Retry the same input only if idempotent or prior effectlessness is proven
dispositions.SCOPE_BLOCKED: Block the out-of-scope task; do not widen writeScope implicitly
dispositions.DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED: Keep the dependent task blocked until the roadmap evidence is accepted

retryAndLineage.toolRetryPrerequisites: Same operation and semantic input; idempotency is established or evidence proves the prior attempt had no effect
retryAndLineage.onExhaustion: Pause the current bounded execution cycle with task identity and all prior evidence preserved. No automatic retry or cap extension. Root may admit a dated numbered cycle under the same taskId only after material new evidence or a corrected implementation plan, linking the prior cycle and reason; cumulative semantic no-progress protection remains active.
retryAndLineage.missingHistory: Block only the affected lineage; never assume zero or silently reset
retryAndLineage.futureResume: Resume within the same stable taskId and current cycle when evidence arrives within remaining caps. After cycle exhaustion, root may admit a new dated numbered cycle only on material new evidence or corrected implementation plan; retain prior history and cumulative semantic no-progress counts.

executionCycle.caps: Implementation repair, submission and deadline caps apply within each bounded cycle

taskEffectBoundary.commitPushPullRequestMerge: Allowed only when already included in the trusted user mandate and within scope. Authorized commit, push or PR creation may collect pending CI evidence; merge and release wait for all applicable gates.
taskEffectBoundary.productionSupabaseAndMigrationProhibitio: Preserve existing user and repository prohibitions. Production, destructive, security-sensitive and migration effects require actual risk-specific grants and evidence; this policy adds no authority.
taskEffectBoundary.missingExternalAuthorityOrCredentials: Typed blocker for the affected action; continue independent eligible work; do not request repeated approval or invent access.

runtimeBoundary.cannotPersistTrustedAuthorityLineageAndR: Preflight does not authenticate mandate or persist workflow state; root reconciles trusted authority and records task history.
runtimeBoundary.legacyPrepareG0Mode: READ_ONLY_STRUCTURAL_AUDIT; NO NEW RESERVATION OR RECEIPT PUBLICATION
runtimeBoundary.draftPreparationCounterEnforcement: LEGACY_V3_ONLY; no v4 ordinary task reservation is created

checks: ROADMAP dependency status and evidence when available
Task writeScope path validity and changed-path scope
ordinaryPreflight.roadmapSources: Derive objective, acceptance, scope and dependency references from the applicable roadmap row when available; a completed dependency exposes its evidence cell. A named revision must resolve and be compatible with the selected base.
ordinaryPreflight.readyMeans: Preflight evidence passed; root still binds the trusted mandate and authorizes only in-scope effects.
ordinaryPreflight.changedPathReporting: --changed includes changedPaths, committedChangedPaths and dirtyPaths in the result; scope checks always run.

examples: Invalid repository path or quoting in the task record
metadataRepair.requiredEffectEvidence: Prove the failed operation had no product effect. If its effect is unknown, quarantine and reconcile read-only.

legacyV3Archive.historicalRunDeadlineAnchor: First draft preparation or G0 attempt for the rootLineageId
legacyV3Archive.historicalFailureSemantics: A reservation preceded candidate reads; malformed JSON consumed a preparation attempt. These counters and anchors are not used for ordinary v4 tasks.
legacyV3Archive.contractsAndReceipts: Preserve WF01 v1 packet, DAG, G0 preparation schemas, source pins, receipts and WF00 SOURCE-RECONCILIATION history unchanged.
